system.sub: Your Complete Roadmap for IELTS Mastery
footer: Aligned with Official IELTS Band Descriptors

skills.name: Speaking
skills.aim: Develop fluent, confident, and natural speaking performance.
skills.result: Develop calm, confident, test-ready speaking performance.
skills.all: All tracks include full practice for IELTS Speaking Parts 1, 2 & 3, with structured feedback and improvement strategies.
coach: Strengthen weak skills for visible progress.
Polish strong areas for higher-band fluency and consistency.

foundation: Develop confidence speaking without long pauses.
Improve clarity and reduce basic sound errors.
Build topic vocabulary for everyday IELTS questions.
Identify common grammar and sentence mistakes.
professional: Maintain natural rhythm and improve stress patterns.
Form longer, accurate sentences using complex tenses.
Organize responses clearly with topic-specific vocabulary.
Use linking words naturally to connect ideas.
mastery: Use idiomatic and academic expressions naturally.
Speak with proper stress, rhythm, and tone variety.
Support opinions with examples and logical reasoning.
Handle unfamiliar topics fluently under timed test pressure.

skills.name: Writing
skills.aim: Master structured, clear, and persuasive writing for Task 1 and Task 2.
skills.result: Write clear, organized, and high-band essays.
skills.all: All tracks include full practice for IELTS Writing Task 1 & Task 2, with structured feedback and improvement strategies.
coach: Strengthen weak areas to boost clarity, structure, and task response.
Polish strong areas for a balanced, high-scoring essay.

foundation: Address all parts of the task clearly (Task 1 & 2).
Organize ideas logically using basic linking words.
Use appropriate vocabulary for common IELTS topics.
Identify and correct basic grammar and sentence errors.
professional: Present clear explanations with supporting details.
Use more complex structures (complex sentences, clauses).
Strengthen summaries, comparisons, graphs, and essay structures.
mastery: Use precise academic vocabulary and natural expressions.
Apply complex structures with high accuracy.
Maintain clear logic in longer, multi-paragraph essays.

skills.name: Reading
skills.aim: Build fast, efficient, and logical reading skills for all passage types.
skills.result: Read smarter, faster, and with full comprehension.
skills.all: All tracks include complete practice for all IELTS Reading question types with structured feedback.
coach: Strengthen weak areas for speed, accuracy, and comprehension.
Polish strong areas for higher-band reading performance and consistency.

foundation: Understand key ideas from short and medium-length texts.
Identify main ideas quickly and locate key details efficiently.
Strengthen essential vocabulary for common IELTS themes.
Improve correct selection for T/F/NG, Matching, and MCQ.
professional: Analyze structure and understand logical relationships.
Practice headings, matching, completion, and inference.
mastery: Analyze long academic texts with depth and precision.
Draw accurate conclusions from implied meaning.
Maintain accuracy under strict exam timing.

skills.name: Listening
skills.aim: Strengthen comprehension, accuracy, and speed across all question types.
skills.result: Understand English naturally across all accents and topics.
skills.all: All tracks include full practice for IELTS Listening Sections 1–4, with structured feedback and improvement strategies.
coach: Improve comprehension, detail detection, and accuracy.
Polish advanced skills for consistency across accents and fast delivery.

foundation: Understand key points from short conversations & monologues.
Improve answers for T/F/NG, matching, MCQ.
professional: Strengthen MCQ, maps, forms, and completion tasks.
mastery: Handle long academic discussions & fast audio.
Interpret implied meaning, tone, and intention.
Manage multi-speaker, opinion-based, and layered info.
Maintain accuracy under real test conditions.
